# javaabu/generators

> Generates a complete, tested Laravel admin resource from a database table: model (with the relations found in the schema), factory, javaabu/permissions policy and permissions, javaabu/filters filters, javaabu/bulk-actions bulk actions, a javaabu/stencil form, controller, routes, Blade (javaabu/forms v2) or Inertia React (@javaabu/forms) pages, and feature tests that pass as generated. Also nests resources, adds javaabu/mediapicker media, makes models translatable (javaabu/translatable) and creates javaabu/auth user types. Reads MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite schemas.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/generators/.

## Rules

- Write and run the migration first: the generated code comes from the schema (types, nullability, defaults, unique, foreign keys, soft deletes, enums). Generate the tables it refers to before it.
- `php artisan generate:all {table}` prints the code; `--create` writes it; existing files are skipped unless `--force`. Run `php artisan permissions:sync` after generating.
- Choose fields with `--index=`, `--form=`, `--show=` (columns, and many-to-many relations by name), or `--interactive`. Pages: `--views=blade|inertia`. Nesting: `--parent=`. Media: `--media=name[:type][:multiple]`. Skip parts with `--except=`.
- Pivot tables aren't resources: generating the two tables gives both a many-to-many relation and a multiple select.
- New user types use `generate:auth {table}` (javaabu/auth v3 ships the auth controllers and pages; never write them). `--migration` writes the table's migration with `UserSchema::columns()`.
- The stencil form validates: don't add a FormRequest; change rules on the form fields. Controllers authorize with the policy (`Gate::authorize()`).
- Name enum classes in a column comment (`enum:App\Enums\X`, MySQL/PostgreSQL) or in `config('generators.enums')` (every driver).
- The admin area's guard, user model, routes file, prefixes, layout and namespaces are config (`generators.admin.*`, `generators.blade.*`, `generators.namespaces.*`); nothing assumes the web guard or App\Models\User.
- Customize what's written by publishing the stubs (`--tag=generators-stubs`) or extending `GenerateCommand` and `Generator`.
